fills.name: Mustering
fills.quote: Influence: Construct military buildings around the Mustering Hall to increase its level to improve the efficiency of mustering warriors. Tier 1: Unlocks mustering of Highland Archers. Adds a muster charge. Tier 2: Reduces cost to muster. Adds a muster charge. Tier 3: Reduces cost to muster. Adds a muster charge. Mustered warrior health is increased. + (c_oaynL66jY 17:25 s_01045) 'Comes with 1 Muster Charge by default.'
fills.note: No on-screen hard cap exists. The value 4 is per Mustering Hall from its own levels: 1 default charge plus 1 per Influence tier, with 3 tiers. The Mustering Hall charge counter matches. In c_oaynL66jY it reads 1 at 17:25, 0 after Muster Pikemen, 1 at Tier 1 (18:17), 2 at Tier 2 (19:17) and 3 at Tier 3 (20:35); 3 of 4 because one was spent. The Three Loch Lookout landmark adds 3 more ('adds 3 muster charges for the Mustering Hall or Three Loch Lookout', c_oaynL66jY 27:03). Each muster type is one-time use, so usable charges are also bounded by the number of muster types.
fills.tieReason: s_00882 (and neighbours s_00886, s_00892, which show the same panel) only shows the Influence text: Tier 1/2/3 each 'Adds a muster charge', and the text is cut off at the scroll arrow. No cap or maximum charge number is shown. Reader A's 4 is a sum (1 default from a different video, c_oaynL66jY, plus 3 tier charges). It is not a stated cap, and it assumes there are no other sources of charges, so it cannot be confirmed from this frame.
